analysis:
Reviewed unit 0 and all replayed evidence, including file metadata. changelog.d/ssd-read-single-copy.md HEAD 3–8 and docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md HEAD 65 describe retaining the buffer returned by a complete read instead of copying it; the reference date also changes. No executable code or tests are supplied. These documentation changes do not independently establish a security regression or a new threat-model gap.
The relevant contract is T-041/A-001/TB-007: encrypted cache data must remain authenticated, account-scoped and bounded in memory, with authoritative file-identity checks. The changed reference still describes authenticated chunks and EOF/file-identity verification. It does not document changes to HMAC naming, key custody, TTL, purge, authorization, attestation, wire encryption or billing. Performance measurements are not evidence that the implementation preserves those controls.
The replay is incomplete (two reviewed source units omitted); the prior analysis's detailed BASE assertions cannot all be independently verified here. Material uncertainty remains in provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDBlockStore.swift readExactly, which is referenced but not supplied: review its complete/partial/empty/truncated-read handling, size and pre-read budget checks, and buffer ownership/indexing with SSDBlockChunkCursor.swift and SSDBlockStore+Streaming.swift. Verify authentication and file-identity failures remain fail-closed and aliases retire before reservation refund, using the changed tests. Missing implementation coverage is not an observed missing control; deeper review is required before concluding that the claimed optimization preserves these contracts.
